verdicts.evidence: lines 540-575: delegated row handler covers paid, remind, undo, retry, dismiss, delete; filter buttons, both clear buttons, panel Try again, dialog Keep and Delete all have listeners that change state and re-render or call the api
lines 420-437: rows come only from api.listInvoices; lines 357-362 and 376-382 compute counts from state.invoices; no hardcoded figures or placeholder text in the markup (lines 137-193)
lines 492-493: delete confirmation shows the invoice number in its title and the customer and amount in its body, so the decision does not rely on the row behind it
The only input is one single-line search field (line 142) and a status filter; no multi-step task, long form or long free text. (Search and filter are kept in the URL anyway, lines 241-242, 289-295.)
lines 496-497: dialog opens with focus on Keep draft, so Enter does not delete; line 147 and 242: default filter is All, so nothing is hidden by default
lines 312-313: Mark as paid and Send reminder are buttons in the table row; line 545-546: one click applies them with no dialog or other screen

lines 139-179: search, status filter, count line and invoice table with row actions; each maps to a brief task (find, see overdue, mark paid, remind, delete draft). No stat cards, charts or extra panels

lines 45-57: all buttons share one outlined style; no filled primary style exists. The dark fill at line 53 marks the pressed filter, not a primary action. Dialog (lines 190-191) has plain Keep draft and outlined danger Delete draft
lines 55-56: delete is a red-outlined button, not filled; line 497: focus starts on Keep draft so Enter does not delete; line 314: Delete appears only on draft rows, which have no other row action

lines 500-505: dialog buttons get aria-disabled only while the delete request is in flight, with the label 'Deleting...' beside them; lines 312-315: actions that do not apply to a row's status are absent, not greyed
No title attributes, tooltips or hover cards anywhere in the markup or the generated row HTML (lines 137-193, 298-333)

Visible strings (lines 137-192, 305-314, 370-384, 492-493, 518, 533) speak only about invoices; no mention of implementation, mock data or the request. 'The connection to the server dropped' is a user-level cause
Only caveat is 'This cannot be undone.' (line 493), inside the delete confirmation at the point of the decision. No banners, tips or disclaimers elsewhere

No sentence narrates the interface. Text is a label (line 141), column headers (170-175), status lines and the empty-state line 374 'New invoices will be listed here', which is the one line an empty view is expected to carry

lines 492-493: dialog title says 'Permanently delete draft X?' and the body ends 'This cannot be undone.', the same fact twice, but the body also adds customer and amount and states the consequence. First and second readings differed
Heading is 'Invoices' (line 137); no greeting, slogan, superlative or exclamation mark in any string (lines 305-314, 370-384, 450-482, 492-533)

lines 158, 190-191, 305-314, 371, 385: 'Clear search and filter', 'Keep draft', 'Delete draft', 'Mark as paid', 'Send reminder', 'Try again', 'Undo', 'Dismiss'. Row 'Delete' sits in its row. Filter toggles (147-151) are option values, not actions

line 227 and 329: status enum values mapped to Overdue, Sent, Draft, Paid; ids (inv_9000) only in data attributes, never shown; dates and money formatted with Intl (lines 256-261); headers are plain words (170-175)

line 370: 'Could not load invoices. The connection to the server dropped.' with Try again; line 309: 'Could not mark as paid.' / 'Could not send the reminder.' with Try again; line 518: 'Could not delete X. The draft is still here. Try again.' The raw ECONNRESET text is never shown
lines 309, 370, 481-482, 518: all errors use 'Could not ...' phrasing; no 'failed', 'invalid', 'oops', exclamation marks or capitals, and the subject is the problem

lines 372-374 and 399: with zero invoices the panel shows 'No invoices yet. New invoices will be listed here.' and the panel button is hidden because panelBtn is empty, so no action or next step is offered

lines 368-385: three separate branches: failed load ('Could not load invoices...' + Try again), nothing exists ('No invoices yet...'), and no match ('No invoices match this search and filter.' + Clear search and filter)

lines 427-431, 368-371: failed load replaces the table with a message and Try again (568-570), search text kept; lines 476-479, 308-310: failed save shows inline row error with Try again and reverts status; lines 516-519: delete failure shown in the open dialog

lines 365-367: skeleton rows and 'Loading invoices' appear at once; line 307: 'Saving...' / 'Sending reminder...' in the row; line 502: 'Deleting...' on the dialog button. Longest wait is two list calls, about 3 seconds

lines 365-367: while loading the table shows skeleton rows and the count reads 'Loading invoices'; line 361: filter counts are blank until ready; empty panel only renders in the ready branch (372-374)

line 78: customer wraps with overflow-wrap anywhere; line 76: amounts nowrap, right aligned, tabular; lines 254, 263: missing amount or date show 'Amount missing' / 'No due date'; line 330: null reminder shows nothing; dialog text wraps (102-103)

lines 577-579: beforeunload prompts while any change is still in its undo window or being sent, or a delete is in flight; search and filter are restored from the URL on return (lines 241-242, 289-295)
line 142: the only field is a free-text search with no format, length or value constraint
line 142: one search field, no form with a mix of required and optional fields
No input validation exists; the search field filters as typed and never reports an error (line 553)
No form that can reject input; the only field is the search box (line 142)
No form that can be rejected by client or server; server actions are row buttons with no entered values
No form that can reject input
No form and no submit button; the search filters on input (line 553)

line 444: begin() returns if work is already pending for the row; line 457: a second click within 500ms cannot hit Undo; line 307: no button is rendered while sending; line 509: confirmDelete returns if busy and the button reads 'Deleting...'

lines 447-448: Mark as paid / Send reminder re-render synchronously to 'Marked as paid' / 'Sending reminder' with Undo; line 513: Delete draft switches to 'Deleting...' before the await; lines 553-559: search and filters render at once; line 51: pressed state

lines 285-288, 329: status cell changes to Paid in place; line 330: 'Reminder sent <date time>' appears in the row; lines 308-310: failures stated in the row; lines 527-533: deleted row removed and notice names the draft

line 533: the only visible success message is 'Draft X deleted.', reporting a removal that leaves nothing on screen to see. Paid and reminder outcomes are shown in the row only; their sr-only announcements (lines 449, 475) are not visible messages

Errors persist in place (lines 308-310, 370, 518). But lines 304-305 and 447: the 'Marked as paid' / 'Sending reminder' message carrying the Undo button is removed by a 6 second timer (UNDO_MS, line 225), so a message with an action auto-dismisses
lines 442-462: mark as paid and send reminder apply on one click with no confirmation and show an Undo button in the row (line 305) that cancels the pending change
lines 487-498: 'Permanently delete draft NW-x?' with customer, amount and 'This cannot be undone.'; buttons 'Keep draft' and 'Delete draft' (190-191); focus set on Keep draft (497)
line 550 is the only path to the dialog: confirmation guards only the permanent delete of a draft. Mark as paid, send reminder, clear and filters run without confirmation

lines 285-288: row shows Paid while work is pending; lines 476-482: on failure the work entry is removed so the status reverts to the stored one, and 'Could not mark as paid.' with Try again is shown in the row (309-310)
lines 185-193: the only modal is a two-button delete confirmation, opened only from the row Delete button (line 550); nothing opens on load

line 496: native dialog opened with showModal(), giving focus trap, Escape and focus return to the trigger; line 497 focuses Keep draft; line 574 blocks Escape only while deleting; lines 524-536 move focus to the next row after a delete
lines 137-179: reading order is heading, search and status filter, count line, then the invoice table, which takes the full width; nothing sits above or outranks it
line 137: plain 'Invoices' heading followed directly by the search, filter and table; no hero, greeting or intro panel

lines 357-362: the only summary numbers are per-status counts inside the filter buttons (e.g. how many are overdue) and the result count (376-382); each tells the user what a filter will show. No cards or charts

lines 376-382: count line reads 'N of M invoices, status Overdue, matching "acme"'; lines 158, 402: 'Clear search and filter' shown beside it when filtered; line 172: sort stated as 'Due (oldest first)'

All controls are native button, input and dialog elements (lines 142-158, 190-191, 301-303); lines 344-350 and 404-416 restore focus to the same row after each redraw, so Undo, Try again and the next row are reachable by keyboard

line 329: overdue status is the word 'Overdue' in a badge, plus 'N days overdue' text (326); errors are worded and bold (87, 309); the pressed filter (53) is also named in the count line 'status Overdue' (378) and via aria-pressed

lines 157, 159, 181-182, 188: role=status count and notice, an aria-live polite region, and role=alert regions all exist in the page on load; lines 430, 449, 461, 475, 480 fill them for load failure, action results and errors
No accordions, disclosure buttons, menus, comboboxes or tabs. The status filters are toggle buttons with aria-pressed (lines 147-151, 359), and the dialog is a native modal

lines 109-132: under 760px rows become stacked grid cards with number, amount, customer, status, a labelled due date and full-width actions; controls are 44px high; search is full width; filters wrap (43); dialog is capped at 100vw - 32px (99)
